answer.rationale: The two acute, measurable regressions are onboarding completion (-4%) and activation (-6%), and the inherited record contains two independent supports for the onboarding/signup lever (memory_86: shortened onboarding lifted completion and time-to-value; memory_31: fewer required signup fields produced a durable first-week activation lift). That lever attacks both regressions at once, which is why it gets the single slot over activation_messaging (memory_91, narrower week-one engagement effect only). Promotional pricing is the tempting answer given the competitor's entry pricing, but memory_73 explicitly records that it bought acquisition at the cost of 30-day retention and warns against generalizing it; under a sustainable long-term qualified revenue objective that is a negative-value trade, so I decline it even though it is the most direct response to the competitive threat. Referral incentives (memory_57) are retention-safe but target established customers, not the leaking SMB funnel. Enterprise sales-assist (memory_44) addresses neither regression this week. I am spending both verification pulls on the memories I am actually acting on rather than on the ones I am declining: I need the original records for memory_86 and memory_31 to confirm effect size, segment, and whether the lift was measured on activation or merely on completion, and to check whether the two are actually one experiment double-counted through consolidation  or/  or which case my evidence base is half as strong as it looks. Downstream value risk: memory_31's mechanism is cutting required fields at signup, and memory_44 says enterprise pipeline quality depends on the sales-assisted demo-request path. Stripping qualifying fields could silently degrade enterprise lead routing and firmographic scoring, trading measured SMB activation for unmeasured qualified pipeline. So I scope the test to SMB self-serve, leave the enterprise demo-request path untouched, and instrument enterprise lead-routing completeness and 30-day retention as guardrail metrics rather than only reading the activation lift. All inherited findings are 15-64 days stale and were measured before this competitor entered; the prior effect sizes are directional, not predictions, and a null result here would be informative rather than surprising.
